witness: decbench coreutils fmt built -O2 and stripped (full_run_address_2026-09-11/O2/coreutils/stripped/fmt), main @0x26a0
phase: P1 (program prep, entry discovery / prototype source)
gating_rationale: It changes emitted C (the declaration line, the argv element type that reaches call sites, and the return statement of a tail call), and AGENTS.md's rule is that anything that can ships behind a named option. Default-ON is the same call machomain made: the name and the declaration are a restatement of the C runtime's contract, not a judgment call, and the ablation restores the previous output exactly.
decisions: The address is oracle 4's own (libc_start_main_target), never a second decode, so the pass cannot disagree with the entry discovery already contains and every architecture oracle 4 covers is covered by construction.

int / char ** is the honest spelling here, unlike entrymainproto's call-site widths: a glibc crt1's first argument is the POSIX main by definition, where the same recovered PE shape can be wmain's wchar_t **.

All three arguments the C runtime passes are declared, `envp` included, because the prototype is applied LOCKED: two parameters is not a weaker claim than three, it asserts there is no third one. On a `main` that reads `envp` that deletes a parameter recovery had already found -- the entry value stops being an input, the read becomes an uninitialised local, and the body still hands it on (armlibcmain_le32 @0x103dc rendered `unsigned int v4; // r2` assigned nowhere and passed to __printf_chk). Nothing readable at load time separates that program from one that truly ignores its third argument: it never touches r2, it forwards it, and only the CALLEE's signature says the register carries a value -- so a read-based body walk sees nothing in either case. Of the two mistakes only one is wrong output.

The image must name __libc_start_main somewhere in its static or dynamic symbol names. Oracle 4's evidence is enough to ADD an entry (a wrong one costs one sub_<addr>) but not to assert the function IS the C main; a fully stripped static image states nothing that separates a glibc crt1 from a hand-rolled entry point and is refused.

The non-PIE ARM32 shape oracle 4 cannot see stays armlibcmain's: elfmain contributes only the prototype there (named_here == false), and because the park is by name, `--option armlibcmain off` leaves nothing for it to land on.

A caller's --define-function name now outranks every discovered name at the same address (declared_names), because naming an address a second time made entry_name_rank's length tie-break decide between an assertion and a discovery.

hunk_classes: naming (all): the definition header and the `(*dat_<got>)(sub_<addr>,...)` argument inside _start's __libc_start_main call both become `main`
declaration (all): the width-only or void signature becomes `int main(int argc,char **argv,char **envp)`
argument spelling at uses: `*a1` -> `*argv`, `a1[optind]` -> `argv[optind]`, `a0` -> `argc`, and on the two ARM fixtures the third register `a2` -> `envp`
return statement: a tail call emitted as a bare statement becomes `return f(...)`, and a widened `return (long)a0` becomes `return argc`, because main's result is no longer void or guessed
local renumbering: declaring the parameters shifts the vN numbering of the remaining locals

expression re-anchoring downstream of the two typed facts -- THIS is the class the in-repo fixtures nearly hide and the real binaries are full of. A `char **argv` instead of an untyped `long` collapses pointer arithmetic into indexing (`v = (long)optind; v = (unsigned long *)(a1 + v*8); v37 = *(char **)v;` becomes `v33 = argv[optind];`), removes casts, and folds a single-use temporary into its use (`v14 = gettext("..."); error(2,0,v14);` becomes `error(2,0,gettext("..."))`); a locked `int` return collapses the early-return shape the guessed width produced (`v = 1; return v;` becomes `return 1;`, and stripped_dynamic_x86_64's two-exit body becomes one). Statements ARE folded, moved and re-anchored by this, and the claim that they are not was wrong. What is measured on the loudest case, grep O0 main: 66 declarations / 599 statement lines become 62 / 487; both arms make the SAME 114 calls to the same 64 distinct callees (the only differing token is the function's own name in its declaration), and keep the same 3 loops, 16 gotos and 7 labels; one `if` becomes a ternary (the header marker goes `ternary x2` -> `ternary x3`) because a single-exit int return lets its two returns re-roll.

parameter demotion past the third (the cost of the LOCKED park, and the one class the in-repo fixtures and the 8 real binaries above BOTH miss): a `main` whose body reads an argument register past the third recovers it as a parameter, because an undefined register read has nowhere else to go, and the lock takes that home away. The value is then dropped from the call site it was handed to, or -- when the body stores it -- declared as a local nothing assigns (`unsigned long v23; // r8` on openssh sftp -O2 @0x5250, still passed to the variadic sub_1e0d0; `unsigned long v22; // r9` on shadow login -O2 @0x3d20, still passed to __snprintf_chk). None of those slots is a real parameter: both unstripped twins' DWARF declares `int main(int argc, char **argv)`, so what the lock changes is how an undefined read is rendered, not whether a parameter survives -- and on coreutils true/false -O2 the same flip turns `undefined16 sub_2540(int a0,unsigned long *a1,unsigned long a2,unsigned long a3)` ending `return v2._0_16_ << 0x40` into `int main(...)` ending `return 0`. Rate over the whole decbench stripped population, measured both arms per image: 775 images, 645 with a main this pass names, 28 recovering more than three parameters, 13 of those 28 gaining a never-assigned register local (docs/features/elfmain/sweep-params/).
regression_sweep.classification: Every hunk is a consequence of the name, the three declared parameters or the int return -- including the last class, which is what the third declared parameter and the lock COST rather than what they buy. The two typed facts propagate, so on a real main the change is not confined to the declaration line: expressions fold and the region shape can change. It is bounded to main and its _start in all 21 images swept, and in the 775-image parameter sweep as well.

parameter_lock.question: what the LOCKED three-parameter prototype does to a main whose body recovers a parameter past the third
parameter_lock.method: kuna functions --filter '^main$' for the address, then kuna decompile-all --addr <it> in both arms, over every stripped ELF in the decbench tree (O0/O2/O2-noinline, all projects); a register local counts as never-assigned when nothing in the body assigns it, takes its address or writes through it
parameter_lock.lost_the_slot_with_no_new_local: 15 -- the body also writes that register somewhere, so the demoted slot becomes an ordinary assigned local (shadow usermod @0x6340: `a5 = *v13` on five paths), or the value goes away with the fabricated slot (coreutils true/false)
parameter_lock.ground_truth: openssh sftp -O2 @0x5250 and shadow login -O2 @0x3d20 both declare `int main(int argc, char **argv)` in their unstripped twin's DWARF, so the extra slots the body recovers are fabrications in either arm
parameter_lock.improvements_in_the_same_class: coreutils true/false -O2 and -O2-noinline: the fabricated fourth slot was producing `undefined16` and `return v2._0_16_ << 0x40`; the locked prototype gives `return 0`

metric.expected: ~0 on decbench type_match, stated up front
metric.why: type_match scores variables[] (arguments + stack symbols). On the functions this fires on, argc/argv are already true positives at the recovered widths wherever the body reads them; return types are not scored and neither is the function name. The gain is the caller-visible return type, the char * element type that reaches argv[i] uses, and a main an agent can ask for by name.

speed.method: Order-alternating paired runs: each iteration times both arms back to back and flips which arm goes first, so a drifting machine cancels; the reported number is the MEDIAN of the per-pair deltas. min-of-N was tried first and rejected -- on this contended box (load average 14, six other worktrees building) the control's min-of-41 delta came out +4.7%, i.e. larger than anything being measured.
speed.control: fauxware `authenticate` (unstripped, the pass refuses, so the true delta is 0), 41 pairs: -0.43% -- the noise floor
speed.reading: All three are inside +-0.5%, and the witness is closer to zero than the control. The pass's per-load work is one pass over the symbol names (which the refusals need anyway) and one more entry in a locked prototype.
